apps.name: POSTAL
apps.subtitle: The 1997 isometric shooter, with touch controls
apps.localizedDescription:
An unofficial fan port of POSTAL (1997), the isometric shooter from Running With Scissors, to iPhone, built from the source code they released, with touch controls made for it.

- Twin-stick touch controls: move with your left thumb, aim and fire with your right
- POSTAL's own wider view fills the screen
- Weapon wheel with the game's own icons and ammo
- Quick save and quick load
- A cheat button: can't die, every weapon, endless ammo, the secret Deathwad
- Jump to any of the 22 levels, Special Delivery and Super Postal included
- Slow motion and a follow cam
- Screenshots straight to Photos

You need your own copy of POSTAL: Classic and Uncut (GOG or Steam); no game files are included. Open the app once, then copy the game's res folder into Files > On My iPhone > POSTAL.

It's a beta: expect bugs, and back up your saves. Multiplayer isn't in the app yet.

Guide and bug reports: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/POSTAL-SourceCode

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Running With Scissors.
